subtasks.text_zh: 从白色桌面上拿起棕色玩偶，放进右侧的白色篮子里。

subtasks.text_en: Grasp the crumpled tissue on the white table and drop it into the left basket.
subtasks.text_zh: 夹住白色桌面上的揉成团的纸巾，松手放到左侧篮子中。

subtasks.text_en: Move the black marker from the white table into the right-side white basket, then return the robot to its home pose.
subtasks.text_zh: 把黑色马克笔从白色桌面移到右侧的白色篮子里，完成后机器人姿态回正。

episodes.instruction_en: Clear the table by picking up the objects in this order: the clear plastic water bottle, the brown plush toy, the crumpled tissue, then the black marker. Put the marker and the plush toy in the right basket, and the water bottle and the tissue in the left basket.
episodes.instruction_zh: 按以下顺序清理桌面：透明塑料水瓶、棕色玩偶、揉成团的纸巾、黑色马克笔。把马克笔和玩偶放进右侧篮子，把水瓶和纸巾放进左侧篮子。

subtasks.text_en: Pick up the clear plastic water bottle from the white table and place it in the white basket on the left.
subtasks.text_zh: 从白色桌面上拿起透明塑料水瓶，放进左侧的白色篮子里。

subtasks.text_en: Grasp the brown plush toy on the white table and drop it into the right basket.
subtasks.text_zh: 夹住白色桌面上的棕色玩偶，松手放到右侧篮子中。

subtasks.text_en: Move the crumpled tissue from the white table into the left-side white basket.
subtasks.text_zh: 把揉成团的纸巾从白色桌面移到左侧的白色篮子里。

subtasks.text_en: Take the black marker off the white table and put it away in the basket on the right, then return the robot to its home pose.
subtasks.text_zh: 将黑色马克笔从白色桌面上取走，收进右边的篮子，完成后机器人姿态回正。
